title: Response of GET /api/bpm/meta, schema version 1
description: What this host's engines are and can do. Requires an authenticated caller; no permission beyond that. Changes are additive within v1. The cockpit turns screens on by feature, never by comparing versions, and supports the current and the previous engine minor version (ADR-0014).

features.description: Feature flags such as rules.simulation, rules.grid-editor, processes.diagram, processes.node-stats.live, processes.node-stats.window, processes.forms, processes.definition-lifecycle, processes.layout, processes.step-catalogue, processes.bpmn-import.

standards.description: Optional. What this module executes, so a federated cockpit renders, validates and offers modeller symbols per host (ADR-0017, standards-compliance.md section 6). Absent means the ADR-0013 subset for processes and rule-set.v1 decision tables for rules.

bpmnStage.description: Highest BPMN stage this host executes.

bpmnExecutableElements.description: BPMN element and event definition names this host executes, for example userTask, boundaryEvent:timer.

settings.description: Host settings the cockpit must respect, for example { "authoring.cockpit-drafts": false }.
